english.title: Make false statement for purpose of obtaining a custody officer certificate

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: CRIMINAL JUSTICE AND PUBLIC ORDER ACT 1994

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of obtaining a certificate for **(..SPECIFY "YOURSELF" OR NAME OTHER PERSON..) certifying that

(A)_[you]_
(B)_[he]_
(C)_[she]_

had been approved by the Secretary of State for the purpose of performing

(D)_[escort functions]_
(E)_[custodial duties]_
(F)_[escort functions and custodial duties]_

in relation to offenders in respect of whom secure training order had been made and that

(G)_[you were]_
(H)_[he was]_
(I)_[she was]_

authorised to perform them, made a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made a statement which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY PARTICULARS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12 of and paragraph 5 of Schedule 2 to the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
for purpose of obtaining a certificate
certifying approval by the Secretary of State
for the purposes of performing escort functions/custodial duties
relating to offenders
subject to secure training orders
made a statement you knew to be false in a material particular

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See section 15 of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994 for the meaning of "custodial duties" and "escort functions".

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
